source.attribution: Jin, Choi, Zhu and Kang, Pervasive Annotation Errors Break Text-to-SQL Benchmarks and Leaderboards (2026); Arcwise-Plat full. Original question/evidence/SQL remain unchanged in the separately fixed source. Pair direction and screening commentary are researcher adaptations.

selection.rule: Bounded manual static screen of same-database source questions: prefer shared population and inspectable differences in aggregation/output; at most two additional current targets. No model outputs, query results or prospective effect estimates used. Not a random sample or preregistered confirmation selection.
selection.origin: Public questions individually; researcher-imposed history-to-current pairing, not observed dialogue chronology or production cache logs
selection.exposure: Development-exposed by this textual screening; not a held-out confirmation set
selection.no_rewrite: Keep all original question, evidence and SQL fields; any later clarification must create a separately attributed adaptation and preserve originals.

pairs.shared_context: Posts owned by users whose DisplayName is csgillespie; same posts-users join
pairs.candidate_relation: Count alone does not determine mean score; supplemented reuse is unresolved, not forbidden
review_gates: Current and historical question/evidence semantics, including entity scope if DisplayName is not unique
Score NULL handling: stored DDL permits NULL, so post count is not automatically COUNT(Score)
Historical result completeness and compatibility of the chosen immutable database
Any extra score/denominator reads and their real cost must be included

pairs.shared_context: SME customers in year 2013; same customers-yearmonth join and filters
pairs.difference: Mean annual consumption per customer divided by 12 versus month of greatest aggregate consumption
pairs.candidate_relation: A scalar annual-derived mean does not determine monthly argmax; base reads remain allowed
review_gates: Retain historical evidence defining AVG(customer annual totals)/12; do not silently change to AVG(monthly rows)
Resolve meaning of a peak month when multiple months tie; current reference uses LIMIT 1 without a tie-breaker
Review missing-month, empty-group and unit interpretation
Historical result completeness and compatibility of the chosen immutable database

pairs.difference: Maximum versus average fastest-lap speed for the same 2009 Spanish Grand Prix
pairs.reason: Saved old schema declares fastestLapSpeed TEXT. Historical reference orders the raw column; current AVG has numeric conversion behavior. This is a static risk, not proof of an actual wrong benchmark answer. Numeric domain/storage and reference intent need review first.

pairs.difference: Percentage carcinogenic within triple-bond molecules versus qualifying molecule IDs
pairs.reason: Adds another information-losing scalar-to-identity relation to an already exposed target; does not replace the existing lossless positive controls or solve their human review gate. Retain as a screened alternative, not a failed experiment.

pairs.difference: Atom-number 19 across matching first endpoints versus distinct bonds incident at either endpoint on TR009_12
pairs.reason: Entity, scope, endpoint handling and counting multiplicity differ together. Not the preferred minimal contrast; requires independent semantic review, not an automatic invalidity label.

positive_control_gap.statement: This bounded screen did not certify a distinct-public-question cache-only conversion. It does not prove none exists in the corpus.
positive_control_gap.consequence: Do not evaluate a reuse method solely on these information-losing candidates. Keep separately labeled same-request repeat and existing researcher-constructed lossless controls pending review; do not relabel them as natural histories.
